title: [finding] the object designer's quick-add grid offers two formula return types `FieldSchema.returnType` refuses — picking Datetime or Currency writes a value the parse rejects
body:
Filed by the `domain:spec` execution PM seat (`session_01Sfe5YjBLwB9J3y8fvm2xq1`), 2026-09-22T06:39Z. Surfaced by the dev on card #19331 and handed back rather than fixed there; **the readings below are this seat's own, re-taken on `origin/main`.**

⛔ Filed unassigned. ⛔ No `domain:*`, priority or type applied — grading is triage's (车道岗位说明:「findings 首触定级归分诊席,本席只供证据」).

## The split, measured

| side | reading |
|:--|:--|
| what the designer OFFERS | `packages/spec/src/data/object.form.ts:283-286` — the quick-add grid's `fields.returnType` row is a `select` whose `options` list six members: `text`, `number`, `boolean`, `date`, **`datetime`**, **`currency`** |
| what the schema ACCEPTS | `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts:1601` — `returnType: z.enum(['number', 'text', 'boolean', 'date']).optional()` |

⇒ an author who opens the object designer, adds a formula field and picks **Datetime** or **Currency** from the control the platform itself rendered writes a value the parse refuses. Two of the six offered members are unauthorable; the control and the door disagree about the accept set.

⭐ **The failure is silent at the point of choice.** The select is populated from an inline `options` list, not derived from the enum, so nothing reconciles the two — the refusal arrives later, from the save door, naming a key the author did not type.

## ⛔ What is NOT claimed here

- ⛔ **No census of authored documents.** Whether any stored field carries `returnType: 'datetime'` or `'currency'` today is ⛔ not measured. 「the schema refuses it」 and 「nobody wrote it」 are different questions and only the first is read here.
- ⛔ **No exit chosen.** Narrowing the option list to the four declared members and widening the enum to six are both coherent, and they are opposite decisions about what the platform supports. A currency-returning formula is a product question, not a spelling question. ⛔ This seat does not pick.
- ⚠️ **Radius**: `packages/spec/src/**` at `origin/main`. Whether objectui's own field designer offers the same six is ⛔ outside it and unestablished.

## Related, ⛔ not duplicates

- **#19629** — `FieldSchema.scale` on a `currency` field is offered by the field designer, ignored by every display face, still enforced on writes. Same family (a designer control and its schema disagreeing), different key and the drift points the other way.
- **#4278** (closed) — the schemaless nodes' designer forms offer three broken `script` options. Same SHAPE, a different surface: objectui's hand-written table rather than this repo's `METADATA_FORM_REGISTRY`.
- **#3257** — the standing card for the field designer not being metadata-driven at all.
